info.title: AppGallery Connect API
info.description: Hand-maintained snapshot of the Huawei AppGallery Connect API, compiled from the pages of the official reference. Huawei does not publish a machine-readable specification. Requests are authorized with the client_id and Authorization headers of an API client; these headers are not listed as operation parameters.

post.summary: Issues an access token for an API client.
post.description: Issues an access token for an API client. The request body carries the client ID and the client secret with grant_type client_credentials; the response has access_token and expires_in (seconds, usually 172800) or, on failure, a ret object with an error code while the HTTP status is still 200. The same endpoint serves team-level API clients and project-level credentials (agc-apiclient file); for project-level credentials the host must match the data processing location of the project.

grant_type.description: This parameter has a fixed value of client_credentials.

client_id.description: Client ID, which is generated when the API client is created.

client_secret.description: Client key, which is generated when the API client is created.

access_token.description: Access token, which is used to call the AppGallery Connect API. This parameter is returned only when a token is successfully obtained.

expires_in.description: Validity period of the access token, in seconds. You need to call this API again to obtain a new access token when the current one expires. The validity period is 48 hours. If the API is called to obtain the value of access_token twice within 48 hours, both access tokens are valid.

get.summary: Finds app IDs by package names.
get.description: Finds app IDs by package names. Returns the app name and the numeric app ID for each package name. Up to 50 package names per call, separated by commas. Other operations address an app by this app ID.

parameters.name: packageName
parameters.description: App package name. Use commas (,) to separate multiple package names. A maximum of 50 package names are supported.

parameters.name: packageTypes
parameters.description: App package type, which will be used to filter app packages. Options: 1: APK 2: RPK 8: EXE (Windows app) Use commas (,) to separate multiple package types.

parameters.name: pcVersionName
parameters.description: Version number used to filter Windows app packages. Valid only when packageTypes is 8 and the query covers a single Windows app.

appids.description: Array of the AppId objects corresponding to specified app package names.

get.summary: Returns app details: basic information, localized listings, review comments and the phased release state.
get.description: Returns app details: basic information, localized listings, review comments and the phased release state. Without lang the listings in all languages are returned. releaseType selects the full release (1) or the phased release (3) version of the data. appInfo.releaseState holds the review and release status of the version.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: ID of an app to be queried.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language. If this parameter is not passed, app information in all languages is queried.

parameters.name: releaseType
parameters.description: App release type. Options: 1: on the entire network 3: by phase The default value is 1.

languages.description: App information in multiple languages. If a language type is passed during query, the app information will be returned in the specified language type. If no language type is passed during query, the app information will be returned in all supported languages.

put.summary: Updates basic app information: default language, categories, privacy policy, price, release countries and other properties.
put.description: Updates basic app information: default language, categories, privacy policy, price, release countries and other properties. Only the passed fields change. The change applies to the draft version and reaches users after the app is submitted and approved. privacyPolicy is always required. For a paid app (isFree 0) pass price or priceDetail. The reference says the operation is not available to individual developers in Russia.

parameters.name: releaseType
parameters.description: App release type. Options: 1: on the entire network 3: by phase The default value is 1.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: ID of an app to be updated.

childType.description: Level-2 category of an app. The ID is fixed.

grandChildType.description: Level-3 category of an app. The ID is fixed.

appNetType.description: App networking type. Options: 1: standalone 2: online

isFree.description: App payment type. Options: 1: free 0: paid If isFree is set to 1, the price and priceDetail parameters are invalid.

price.description: App price as a JSON string that maps a country or region code to a price, for example {"DE":"2.50"}. Required for a paid app (isFree 0). The store adjusts the final price by its regional price rules.

priceDetail.description: Prices by country or region as a JSON array string, for example [{"country":"DE","currency":"EUR","price":"2.50"}]. Required for a paid app (isFree 0). The store adjusts the final price by its regional price rules.

publishCountry.description: Release countries and regions: comma-separated codes, for example CN,DE,MC. OTHER adds the countries and regions that AppGallery starts to support later; it cannot be the only value.

isAppForcedUpdate.description: Indicates whether an app is forcibly updated. Options: 0: no 1: yes

hispaceAutoDown.description: Indicates whether to allow AppGallery to capture an app package from the Internet. Options: 0: no 1: yes

appTariffType.description: Type of an in-app purchase item. Options: 1: activation 2: item 3: unlocking a game level 4: virtual coin 5: paid chapter 6: others 7: course 8: membership Multiple values are supported. Use commas (,) to separate them, for example, 1,2,3.

publicationNumber.description: Publication approval number. This parameter applies only to game apps.

cultureRecordNumber.description: Internet culture operation license (China only). This parameter applies only to game apps.

developerNameCn.description: Chinese name of a developer. This parameter can be modified only for developers on the trustlist.

developerNameEn.description: English name of a developer. This parameter can be modified only for developers on the trustlist.

familyShareTag.description: Indicates whether an app can be shared among family members. Options: 0: no 1: yes

webGameFlag.description: Indicates whether an app is a browser game. Options: 0: no 1: yes This parameter is valid only for mobile RPK games and when compatible devices include Windows devices (the values of appAdapters include 15).

privacyRightsUrl.description: URL for users to add, delete, modify, and view their personal data.

encrypted.description: Indicates whether to encrypt the package. Options: 0: no 1: yes The default value is 1.

put.summary: Adds or updates the app listing in one language: name, full and brief description, what is new.
put.description: Adds or updates the app listing in one language: name, full and brief description, what is new. If the app has no listing in this language yet, it is created, and appName is required then. The change applies to the draft version and reaches users after the app is submitted and approved.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: ID of the app whose localization information needs to be updated.

parameters.name: releaseType
parameters.description: App release type. Options: 1: on the entire network 3: by phase The default value is 1.

appName.description: App name in a language. This parameter is mandatory when a language type is added.

delete.summary: Deletes the app listing in one language.
delete.description: Deletes the app listing in one language. The listing in the default language cannot be deleted.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: ID of the app whose localization information needs to be deleted.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language in which localization information needs to be deleted.

parameters.name: releaseType
parameters.description: App release type. Options: 1: on the entire network 3: by phase The default value is 1.

put.summary: Attaches uploaded files to the app: the app package, icon, screenshots, videos, certificates.
put.description: Attaches uploaded files to the app: the app package, icon, screenshots, videos, certificates. Call it after the file was uploaded through the Upload Management API: files[].fileDestUrl is the object ID returned with the upload URL. fileType tells what the files are; for images and videos lang is required. For an app package (fileType 5) the response has pkgVersion with the package IDs; the package is parsed asynchronously, so wait a couple of minutes before submitting the app.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: ID of an app to be updated.

parameters.name: releaseType
parameters.description: App release type. Options: 1: on the entire network 3: by phase The default value is 1.

lang.description: Language. This parameter is mandatory for updating images and videos.

imgShowType.description: Screenshot display mode. Options: 0: portrait 1: landscape This parameter is mandatory when fileType is set to 2.

videoShowType.description: Video display mode. Options: 0: portrait 1: landscape This parameter is mandatory when fileType is set to 1. The actual display mode (landscape or portrait) of videos and posters must be consistent with that specified by videoShowType.

clearArk.description: Indicates whether to clear the Ark package (used for update from Android+Ark to Android). Options: 1: yes 0: no The default value is 0.

fileType.description: What the files are: 0 app icon; 1 introduction videos with posters (up to three pairs, each video before its poster); 2 screenshots; 3 promotion video with its poster; 4 promotion image; 5 app package (RPK, APK, AAB); 6 agent certificate or copyright image; 7 electronic certificate (PDF, up to 5 MB); 8 screenshot of the Internet culture operation license; 9 Internet culture operation license (image or PDF, games only); 10 VR cover; 11 VR screenshot; 12 VR promotion image; 13 VR cover layering image; 14 VR promotion image 4:3; 15 VR promotion image 1:1; 16 VR panorama.

deviceType.description: Device type. Options: 4: mobile phone 6: VR gadget 7: watch 8: Vision 9: router 10: telematics device This parameter is mandatory when visual assets need to be updated for an app that supports multiple device types.

pkgVersion.description: Package ID. This parameter is returned only by the API with a package added. Currently, only one record is supported.

post.summary: Submits the app version for review and release.
post.description: Submits the app version for review and release. The app information must be complete and the package uploaded and parsed (about two minutes after the upload). Without releaseTime the version is released right after approval. With releaseType 3 the version is released by phase: the body must then carry the phased release start and end time, percentage and description, and the app must already have a released version. Submission starts the review and cannot be undone through the API.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: App ID.

parameters.name: releaseTime
parameters.description: Release time in UTC format. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZZ. Example: 2015-01-01T01:01:01+0800 If releaseTime is not specified, the app will be released immediately after being approved.

parameters.name: remark
parameters.description: Remarks. This parameter can be left empty. If this parameter is set, the value contains 10 to 300 characters.

parameters.name: releaseType
parameters.description: App release type. Options: 1: on the entire network 3: by phase If this parameter is set to 3, your app must have a version that has already been released. The default value is 1.

state.description: It is unnecessary to set the parameter.

phasedReleaseStartTime.description: Start time of phased release, in UTC format. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZZ. Example: 2015-01-01T01:01:01+0800

phasedReleaseEndTime.description: End time of phased release, in UTC format. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZZ. Example: 2015-01-01T01:01:01+0800

phasedReleasePercent.description: Share of users in the phased release, from 0.00 to 100.00 with up to two decimal places, without the percent sign.

isPureDetection.description: Indicates whether to request green app certification. Options: 0: no 1: yes

sensitivePermissionIconUrl.description: Object ID of the green app certification material (a ZIP archive uploaded through the Upload Management API). Required when isPureDetection is 1.

isCommitSensitivePermissionTips.description: Confirms that the app has no prohibited functions (intrusive pop-ups and ads, undeletable notifications, prompts to enable developer options or USB debugging, malicious hot patches). Required and must be true when isPureDetection is 1.

post.summary: Submits the app for review and release with a package that Huawei downloads from the given URL.
post.description: Submits the app for review and release with a package that Huawei downloads from the given URL. Huawei downloads the package from downloadUrl and starts the release process; the result is reported asynchronously to callbackAddr with the given requestId. For release by phase pass releaseType 3 and phasedReleaseInfo. The reference says that developers outside the Chinese mainland can use it only when the release countries include the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: App ID.

releaseTime.description: Release time in UTC format. If this parameter is left empty, the app is released immediately after being approved. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZZ. Example: 2015-01-01T01:01:01+0800

remark.description: Remarks. This parameter can be left empty. If this parameter is set, the value contains 10 to 300 characters.

releaseType.description: App release type. Options: 1: on the entire network 3: by phase The default value is 1.

downloadUrl.description: URL from which Huawei downloads the package (APK, RPK, AAB or EXE). Size limits: APK and EXE 4 GB, AAB 150 MB, RPK 20 MB for quick apps and 30 MB for quick games.

downloadFileName.description: Name of the to-download file in downloadUrl, including the file name extension.

callbackAddr.description: Callback URL for releasing an app, which is configured by you. Huawei server calls the API for obtaining the callback result to notify your server of the app release result through the URL.

requestId.description: Request string defined by you. The value must be unique. This parameter is carried in the result callback.

clearArk.description: Indicates whether to clear the Ark package (used for update from Android+Ark to Android). Options: 1: yes 0: no The default value is 0.

phasedReleaseInfo.description: Phased release information. This parameter is mandatory when releaseType is set to 3.

versionName.description: Version number of a Windows app package. This parameter is mandatory for EXE packages.

displayName.description: Name displayed in the registry, which uniquely identifies a Windows app. This parameter is mandatory for EXE packages.

isPureDetection.description: Indicates whether to request green app certification. Options: 0: no 1: yes

sensitivePermissionIconUrl.description: Object ID of the green app certification material (a ZIP archive uploaded through the Upload Management API). Required when isPureDetection is 1.

isCommitSensitivePermissionTips.description: Confirms that the app has no prohibited functions (intrusive pop-ups and ads, undeletable notifications, prompts to enable developer options or USB debugging, malicious hot patches). Required and must be true when isPureDetection is 1.

put.summary: Changes the phased release: suspends or resumes it, changes its dates, percentage and description, or switches to full release.
put.description: Changes the phased release: suspends or resumes it, changes its dates, percentage and description, or switches to full release. With releaseType 3 (default) the body updates the phased release settings; state SUSPEND pauses it and RELEASE resumes it. With releaseType 1 the phased release becomes a release to all users: pass an empty object as the body.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: App ID.

parameters.name: releaseType
parameters.description: Release type to be changed. You can change the release type from release by phase to full release. Options: 1: on the entire network For release on the entire network, set Body to {}. 3: by phase The default value is 3.

state.description: Status of the release by phase. Options: SUSPEND: suspended RELEASE: released

phasedReleaseStartTime.description: Start time of phased release, in UTC format. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZZ. Example: 2015-01-01T01:01:01+0800 The start time of a released app cannot be changed.

phasedReleaseEndTime.description: End time of phased release, in UTC format. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZZ. Example: 2015-01-01T01:01:01+0800

phasedReleasePercent.description: Phased release percentage. The value must be greater than 0.00 and less than 100.00, accurate to two decimal places. Do not include a percent sign (%) in the value.

put.summary: Sets whether the app depends on Google Mobile Services.
put.description: Sets whether the app depends on Google Mobile Services. needGms 1 declares that the app needs GMS, 0 that it does not.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: App ID.

needGms.description: Indicates whether an app depends on GMS. Options: 0: no 1: yes

put.summary: Changes the release time of an approved version that waits for its scheduled release.
put.description: Changes the release time of an approved version that waits for its scheduled release. Works only while the app is in the Releasing state. changeType 2 releases the version immediately, changeType 3 moves the scheduled release to releaseTime.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: App ID.

changeType.description: Modification type. Options: 2: change the release time from a scheduled time to immediately 3: change the scheduled release time

releaseTime.description: Version release time in UTC format. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZZ. Example: 2015-01-01T01:01:01+0800 This parameter is valid when changeType is set to 3.

releaseType.description: App release type. Options: 1: on the entire network Currently, only this option is supported.

get.summary: Returns the compilation status of uploaded app packages (AAB).
get.description: Returns the compilation status of uploaded app packages (AAB). pkgIds are the pkgVersion values returned when the package was attached to the app or by the package list.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: App ID.

parameters.name: pkgIds
parameters.description: App package IDs for query, separated by commas (,). This parameter corresponds to the pkgVersion parameter returned by the API for querying the package list.

post.summary: Uploads an app package that Huawei downloads from the given URL, without submitting the app.
post.description: Uploads an app package that Huawei downloads from the given URL, without submitting the app. The package is only added to the app: it is not attached to a version and nothing is released. The result is reported asynchronously to callbackAddr with the given requestId. The reference says that developers outside the Chinese mainland can use it only when the release countries include the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: App ID.

downloadUrl.description: Download URL of your app package. APK file: The size cannot exceed 4 GB. RPK file: The size cannot exceed 20 MB for quick apps and 30 MB for quick games. AAB file: The size cannot exceed 150 MB. EXE file (Windows app): The size cannot exceed 4 GB.

downloadFileName.description: Name of the file matching downloadUrl, including the file name extension.

callbackAddr.description: Callback URL, which is configured by you. Huawei server calls the API for obtaining the callback result to notify your server of the submission result through the URL.

requestId.description: Request string defined by you. The value must be unique. This parameter is carried in the result callback.

versionName.description: Version number of a Windows app package. This parameter is mandatory for EXE packages.

displayName.description: Name displayed in the registry, which uniquely identifies a Windows app. This parameter is mandatory for EXE packages.

packageType.description: App package type. 1: APK 2: RPK 8: EXE (Windows app)

get.summary: Lists the packages of the app.
get.description: Lists the packages of the app. Returns package IDs (pkgVersion), file names, version codes and names, sizes, upload times and expansion files. Paged with fromRecCount (starts at 1) and maxReqCount (up to 100).

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: App ID.

parameters.name: fromRecCount
parameters.description: ID of the record where the query starts. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: maxReqCount
parameters.description: Number of packages to be queried. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 10.

pkgList.description: Information of the app package list.

packagePath.description: Complete URL for downloading the uploaded APK. The URL is valid for 5 minutes.

abisType.description: CPU architecture type. Options: 1: 32-bit (armeabi-v7a|armeabi|x86|mips) 2: 64-bit (armeabi-v8a|x86_64|mips64) 3: 32-bit and 64-bit The default value is 3.

get.summary: Returns a one-time URL and request headers for uploading a file to the Huawei file storage.
get.description: Returns a one-time URL and request headers for uploading a file to the Huawei file storage. Used for app packages (APK, AAB, RPK, APP, EXE), images, videos and PDF files. The URL is valid for about five minutes. The file is then sent to that URL with the returned method and headers, and urlInfo.objectId is passed as fileDestUrl when the file is attached to the app. The URL and headers are credentials.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: App ID.

parameters.name: fileName
parameters.description: Original file name, including the file name extension. This parameter is used to obtain the original file name extension when the upload URL is generated.

parameters.name: sha256
parameters.description: SHA-256 hash value of the app package content. If this parameter is passed, the integrity of an uploaded app package will be verified. If this parameter is not passed, verification is not performed.

parameters.name: contentLength
parameters.description: File size, in bytes.

parameters.name: releaseType
parameters.description: App release type. Options: 1: full release 6: HarmonyOS test release (API version 10 or later) The default value is 1.

parameters.name: chineseMainlandFlag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to distribute the package to the Chinese mainland. Options: 0: no 1: yes If your registration location is not the Chinese mainland, the chineseMainlandFlag parameter is mandatory.

urlInfo.description: File upload information, including the request method, file upload URL, and request header.

post.summary: Starts a chunked upload of a large file.
post.description: Starts a chunked upload of a large file. Returns objectId and nspUploadId for the next calls and the allowed chunk size range. fileType tells whether the file is a HarmonyOS package, an APK expansion file (default) or an Android package.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: App ID.

parameters.name: fileName
parameters.description: Original file name, including the file name extension.

parameters.name: contentType
parameters.description: Object content type, which complies with the content-type format in an HTTP header, for example, image/jpeg. If the parameter is left empty, the value application/octet-stream is used by default.

parameters.name: fileType
parameters.description: File type. Options: 1: APP (HarmonyOS app or atomic service package) 2: OBB (APK expansion file) 3: APK (Android package, including APK and AAB formats) Default value: 2

parameters.name: releaseType
parameters.description: App release type. Options: 1: full release 6: HarmonyOS test release (API version 10 or later)

parameters.name: obbType
parameters.description: Type of an OBB file. Options: 1: main expansion file 2: patch expansion file This parameter is mandatory when an OBB file is uploaded. Before uploading an OBB file, ensure that the latest version of your app has been associated with the corresponding APK.

parameters.name: chineseMainlandFlag
parameters.description: Indicates whether to distribute the package to the Chinese mainland. Options: 0: no 1: yes If fileType is set to 1 and your registration location is not the Chinese mainland, the chineseMainlandFlag parameter is mandatory.

objectId.description: Generated object ID. This ID is used when you call the API for obtaining chunk upload URLs.

nspPartMinSize.description: Minimum size of a chunk, in bytes. The default value is 5 MB.

nspPartMaxSize.description: Maximum size of a chunk, in bytes. By default, the maximum size of a chunk is 1024 MB.

nspUploadId.description: File upload ID. This ID is used when you call the API for obtaining chunk upload URLs.

post.summary: Returns upload URLs for the chunks of a chunked upload.
post.description: Returns upload URLs for the chunks of a chunked upload. The body maps a chunk ID (additionalProp1, additionalProp2, ...) to the chunk size and optional SHA-256. Each URL is valid for about four minutes. The URLs and headers are credentials.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: Object ID, which must be the same as the value of objectId generated during chunk information initialization.

parameters.name: nspUploadId
parameters.description: Upload ID, which must be the same as the value of nspUploadId generated during chunk information initialization.

schema.description: Chunk details. The X variable indicates the chunk ID, with the number at the end of the ID starting from 1, for example, additionalProp1 and additionalProp2.

uploadInfoMap.description: Map object that contains the chunk URLs. The key parameter indicates the chunk ID (for example, additionalProp1 and additionalProp2), and the value parameter indicates the FilePartUploadInfo entity class that contains the chunk URL information.

post.summary: Merges the uploaded chunks into one file.
post.description: Merges the uploaded chunks into one file. The body maps each chunk ID to its partObjectId and the ETag returned by the storage when the chunk was uploaded.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: Object ID, which must be the same as the value of objectId generated during chunk information initialization.

parameters.name: nspUploadId
parameters.description: Upload ID, which must be the same as the value of nspUploadId generated during chunk information initialization.

schema.description: Chunk information. In the parameter name, X indicates the chunk ID, for example, additionalProp1 and additionalProp2. The value of X must be the same as the chunk ID returned by the API for obtaining chunk upload URLs.

get.summary: Returns a temporary link to the download and installation report of the app (CSV or Excel).
get.description: Returns a temporary link to the download and installation report of the app (CSV or Excel). The period between startTime and endTime (YYYYMMDD, UTC) is up to 180 days. Data can be filtered and grouped by date, country or region, business type and app version. The link is temporary: download the file right away.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: App ID.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Query language. The report title can be displayed in different languages. Only Simplified Chinese (zh-CN), English (en-US), and Russian (ru-RU) are supported.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Query start time in UTC time. The format is YYYYMMDD. The interval between startTime and endTime cannot exceed 180 days.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Query end time in UTC time. The format is YYYYMMDD. The interval between startTime and endTime cannot exceed 180 days.

parameters.name: filterCondition
parameters.description: Filters to apply; repeat the parameter for each filter: countryId, businessType, appVersion. Each filter needs a filterConditionValue in the same position.

parameters.name: filterConditionValue
parameters.description: Values of the filters, in the same order as filterCondition. countryId: country or region codes (all for global data, others for the group of US, CU, IR, SD and SY). businessType: ALL, AppGallery or AppTouch (case sensitive). appVersion: versions separated by commas, or all.

parameters.name: groupBy
parameters.description: Statistics dimension. Options: date: by date. countryId: by country/region. businessType: by business type. appVersion: by app version. The default value is date.

parameters.name: exportType
parameters.description: Exported file type. Options: CSV EXCEL The default value is CSV.

fileURL.description: Path for storing a CSV or an Excel file. The report language is specified by language. The first parameter is the data statistics group type specified by groupBy. For example, if the report language is English, click Sample File.zip to download a sample file in English.

get.summary: Returns a temporary link to the in-app purchases report of the app (CSV or Excel).
get.description: Returns a temporary link to the in-app purchases report of the app (CSV or Excel). Amounts are converted to the given currency (CNY, EUR or USD). The period between startTime and endTime is limited; see the parameter descriptions. The link is temporary: download the file right away.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: App ID.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Query language. The report title can be displayed in different languages. Only Simplified Chinese (zh-CN), English (en-US), and Russian (ru-RU) are supported.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Query start time in UTC time. The format is YYYYMMDD. The interval between startTime and endTime cannot exceed 180 days.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Query end time in UTC time. The format is YYYYMMDD. The interval between startTime and endTime cannot exceed 180 days.

parameters.name: filterCondition
parameters.description: Filter. Options: countryId: by country/region. businessType: by business type. If this parameter is not passed, no filter is used by default. Filters countryId and businessType can be used at the same time. URL example: &filterCondition=countryId&filterCondition=businessType

parameters.name: filterConditionValue
parameters.description: Values of the filters, in the same order as filterCondition. countryId: country or region codes (all for global data, others for the group of US, CU, IR, SD and SY). businessType: ALL, AppGallery or AppTouch (case sensitive).

parameters.name: groupBy
parameters.description: Statistics dimension. Options: date: by date. countryId: by country/region. businessType: by business type. The default value is date.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency of the amounts in the report: CNY, EUR or USD. Amounts in other currencies are converted at the exchange rate.

parameters.name: exportType
parameters.description: Format of an exported file. Options: CSV EXCEL The default value is CSV.

fileURL.description: Path for storing a CSV or an Excel file. The report language is specified by language. The first parameter is the data statistics group type specified by groupBy. For example, if the report language is English, click Sample File.zip to download a sample file in English.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: App ID.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Keyword of the comment content. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: beginTime
parameters.description: Query start timestamp. The value is the total number of milliseconds since 1970-01-01 08:00:00.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Query end timestamp. The value is the total number of milliseconds since 1970-01-01 08:00:00. The interval between beginTime and endTime cannot exceed six months.

parameters.name: countries
parameters.description: Country/Region code, for example, CN. Separate multiple country/region with commas (,). However, only countries/regions managed by the same site can be queried at a time. Ensure that you pass only the listed country/region codes.

parameters.name: ratings
parameters.description: Ratings to include, from 1 to 5, separated by commas (for example 4,5). All ratings by default.

parameters.name: apkVersions

parameters.name: auditStates
parameters.description: Deprecated. Review status. If this parameter is not set, comments in all review statuses are queried by default.

parameters.name: limit

put.description: Writes a new version of the Remote Configuration of an app: all parameters and conditions. The new version takes effect for the users of the app at once: there is no draft and no review. The body describes the whole configuration (configItems and filters as returned by the read operation, with the changes applied); a parameter or condition missing from the body is most likely deleted. version must be the latest version number (0 when the app has no configuration yet): if the configuration was changed after it was read, the request fails with result code 204083201 and nothing is written. The response has the new version number. Rate limit: 5 requests per second and 1000 per hour per IP address.

parameters.name: productId

The response has the new version number. Rate limit: 5 requests per second and 1000 per hour per IP address.

post.summary: Creates a short link of an App Linking cross-platform link.
post.description: Creates a short link of an App Linking cross-platform link. The link is made from a long link (`longUrl`) or from link details (`linkInfo`; it wins when both are passed). The URL prefix (`uriPrefix`, like `https://example.drcn.agconnect.link`) must be requested in AppGallery Connect > the project > App Linking beforehand. The link is public: anyone who gets it can open it until it expires (two years by default, `expireTime`). Links created through the API are not shown in AppGallery Connect, and the API cannot list, change or delete them: check the details before creating a link that will be sent to users. Up to 100,000 short links per project per day.

expireTime.description: Validity period of the short link in seconds, an integer greater than 300. Default: two years.

testUrl.description: Test URL that shows the preview of the link.

post.summary: Creates an App Linking unified download link.
post.description: Creates an App Linking unified download link. It is one link that opens the app page in the store of the user's device (App Store on iOS, AppGallery on Android devices with AppGallery, another store such as Google Play otherwise) and the default link elsewhere. The URL prefix (`uriPrefix`) must be requested in AppGallery Connect > the project > App Linking beforehand. The link is public. Links created through the API are not shown in AppGallery Connect, and the API cannot list, change or delete them; a project can have up to 2000 unified download links, so do not create links just to try.

post.summary: Verifies the purchase token of a consumable or non-consumable and returns its purchase data.
post.description: Verifies the purchase token of a consumable or non-consumable and returns its purchase data. Only the latest purchase token of a product can be verified: after a consumable is confirmed and bought again, the earlier token returns result code 12. Check that productId, price and currency of the purchase data match the order before delivering the product. For subscriptions use the subscription query (`get_subscription_purchase`).

post.summary: Confirms that a purchased consumable was delivered, so that the user can buy it again.
post.description: Confirms that a purchased consumable was delivered, so that the user can buy it again. Call it only after the product is delivered: without the confirmation the consumable cannot be bought again. It does the same as consumeOwnedPurchase of the IAP client, but the client cache is not refreshed, so obtainOwnedPurchases on the device can still return the purchase. Result code 9 means the purchase is already confirmed.

post.summary: Lists purchases canceled or refunded in the last 30 days.
post.description: Lists purchases canceled or refunded in the last 30 days. type 0 returns consumables and non-consumables, type 1 also subscriptions. startAt and endAt are UTC timestamps in milliseconds within the last 30 days (by default the whole 30 days). A page has at most maxRows records (1000 by default and at most). When the response has continuationToken, pass it in the body of the next call to get the next page: startAt, endAt and type are ignored then. The records carry no signature.

cancelledPurchaseList.description: Canceled or refunded purchases as a JSON string (an array of CancelledPurchase).

continuationToken.description: Token of the next page; pass it in the next request. Missing on the last page.

post.summary: Lists payment and refund orders paid within a period of at most 48 hours.
post.description: Lists payment and refund orders paid within a period of at most 48 hours. startAt and endAt are UTC timestamps in milliseconds; endAt is later than startAt by at most 48 hours, and only orders whose payment time (tradeTime) falls in the period are returned. Orders of the current day can still change: query the previous day. When the response has continuationToken, pass it in the body of the next call to get the next page.

continuationToken.description: Token of the next page; pass it in the next request. Missing on the last page.

post.summary: Returns the latest purchase data of a subscription, including whether it is valid now.
post.description: Returns the latest purchase data of a subscription, including whether it is valid now. For subscriptions only; for consumables and non-consumables use `verify_product_purchase`. In the purchase data subIsvalid tells whether the user has access now and expirationDate when the current period ends.

dataSignature.description: Signature of inappPurchaseData made with the IAP private key of the app.

signatureAlgorithm.description: Signature algorithm, for example SHA256WithRSA or SHA256WithRSA/PSS.

post.summary: Cancels a subscription: it stays valid until the end of the paid period but is not renewed.
post.description: Cancels a subscription: it stays valid until the end of the paid period but is not renewed. Payments already made are not refunded.

post.summary: Defers the next billing date of a subscription.
post.description: Defers the next billing date of a subscription. desiredExpirationTime must be later than currentExpirationTime (the end of the current period) by 1 to 365 days. The user keeps access and is not charged during the deferral. The billing date can be deferred again before the new date comes.

post.summary: Refunds the latest payment of a subscription without canceling it.
post.description: Refunds the latest payment of a subscription without canceling it. Only the most recent payment is refunded, and only once; the subscription stays valid and keeps renewing. In the sandbox and for products priced 0 the refund completes at once. Other payments are refunded only through Huawei support.

post.summary: Revokes a subscription at once and refunds its latest payment.
post.description: Revokes a subscription at once and refunds its latest payment. The user loses access immediately and the subscription is not renewed. The refund can take some time to reach the user. Huawei suggests it for suspected fraud.

post.description: Queries the latest status of a consumable, non-consumable or non-renewable subscription order. HarmonyOS 5 and later (IAP Kit). Called after a key event notification, before the product is delivered.

post.description: Acknowledges that a consumable, non-consumable or non-renewable subscription was delivered. HarmonyOS 5 and later (IAP Kit). Each purchaseOrderId can be acknowledged only once.

post.description: Queries payment and refund orders within a time range of at most 48 hours. HarmonyOS 5 and later (IAP Kit). Only the last 180 days; sandbox and zero-amount orders are not returned. Query the previous day rather than the current one: orders of the current day can still change.

post.description: Queries the latest status of an auto-renewable subscription. HarmonyOS 5 and later (IAP Kit). Called after a key event notification, before the subscription is delivered.

post.description: Acknowledges that a subscription was delivered. HarmonyOS 5 and later (IAP Kit). Each purchaseOrderId can be acknowledged only once.

post.description: Postpones the next renewal date of an active auto-renewable subscription by 1 to 90 days. HarmonyOS 5 and later (IAP Kit). Not for expired subscriptions or free trials; at most two postponements per subscription in 365 days. The user is not charged for the extra days.
